reason: Design only, no code. Records in design/dreamer-agent-loop/13-doctrine.md that D9 — make the Dreamer's doctrine shape-aware, decided 2026-08-22 as the minimum change that fixes the class rather than one instance — was never taken, and that the doctrine rewrite which landed on 2026-09-08 went the other way: it committed the single preamble to the judge shape instead of making it aware that there is more than one shape. The measurement behind that rewrite is real and is quoted in full, and it is narrow: one adaptor, one scenario suite, at a time when the only adaptors that existed were judges. The doctrine is served to every adaptor on every run, so a result measured on one shape became the contract for shapes that did not exist yet. It now tells every adaptor to answer from the text it was handed, while the tool registry exposes 35 read-only verbs and a grant mechanism exists to make the room-scoped ones resolve. One shipped objective already argues against its own preamble. The node proposes no replacement text and states what must be true before one is written, including that the judge result must be re-measured rather than traded away. Nothing a member of a room can observe.
